name: Remix TradeCare Africa - Integrated Agri-Services Ecosystem
description: Official website for TradeCare Africa, a women-led Kenyan agri-services company founded by Joyce Wambui Gema. Five integrated divisions: Train (TradeCare Academy), Produce (Zao Safi Hub), Digitise (FarmDataPod), Assure (React Cert Africa), and Connect (TradeCare Market).
